title: Therapeutic potential of Isatidis Radix alkaloids in RSV pneumonia: A focus on AhR-mediated pulmonary barrier repair.
authors: Xu, Shaobao; Hou, Xianbang; Xu, Yingji; Wang, Xin; Xu, Lingfeng; He, Liwei
one_liner_zh: 研究板蓝根生物碱通过AhR通路修复RSV肺炎肺屏障，虽含分子对接但核心为药理机制与湿实验，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: The traditional use of Isatis tinctoria L. (Isatidis Radix) in East Asian medicine centers on managing febrile diseases and various respiratory ailments. Classical medical texts document its function of "clearing heat and detoxifying". These traditional applications are highly consistent with its reported therapeutic effects against viral pneumonia. However, its clinical efficacy in treating respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) pneumonia and the underlying regulatory mechanisms involved have not been systematically elucidated. AIM OF THE STUDY: This research sought to evaluate the therapeutic efficacy and prospects of Isatidis Radix alkaloids (IRA) in RSV pneumonia and to elucidate the molecular mechanisms underlying their role in restoring pulmonary barrier integrity. MATERIALS AND METHODS: By employing bioinformatics in conjunction with molecular docking, the initial step was to screen for the bioactive constituents within Isatidis Radix and their corresponding key targets, and to predict their potential mechanisms of action. We next constructed an RSV pneumonia mouse model for evaluating IRA-mediated changes in immune organ parameters, cytokine production, and lung histology. The impact of IRA on immunomodulation was then assessed using flow cytometry, qPCR analysis, and various other methods. Following this, epithelial barrier repair was evaluated by Western blotting and the Evans blue assay. Ultimately, we verified that the barrier-protective effect of IRA is specifically mediated by the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) using techniques such as gene silencing and Western blotting, along with other assays. Finally, an AhR knockout (AhR KO) mouse model of RSV pneumonia was utilized to verify the specificity of the IRA-mediated barrier protection for AhR. RESULTS: Alkaloids were identified as the principal active constituents of Isatidis Radix mediating its anti-RSV pneumonia effect, based on bioinformatics analysis and molecular docking results, and AhR was identified as a key target. In the RSV pneumonia mouse model, IRA significantly restored immune organ function, improved inflammatory cytokine levels, upregulated the expression of tight junction proteins, and enhanced pulmonary barrier integrity. Subsequent mechanistic investigation revealed that the activation of AhR served as the primary pathway mediating the effects of IRA. Most importantly, AhR knockout completely abolished the protective effect of IRA on barrier function, confirming that this effect is dependent on the AhR pathway. CONCLUSION: Our study demonstrates that IRA exerts its therapeutic effect against RSV pneumonia and repairs the lung epithelial barrier by modulating AhR activity. These findings indicate that IRA possesses potential value in the treatment of RSV pneumonia.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：东亚医学中传统使用菘蓝（Isatidis Radix）的核心在于治疗发热性疾病及多种呼吸道疾病。经典医学文献记载其具有“清热解毒”的功能。这些传统应用与其报道的抗病毒性肺炎治疗效果高度一致。然而，其在治疗呼吸道合胞病毒（RSV）肺炎中的临床疗效及所涉及的潜在调控机制尚未得到系统阐明。研究目的：本研究旨在评估菘蓝生物碱（IRA）在RSV肺炎中的治疗功效及应用前景，并阐明其在恢复肺屏障完整性中作用的分子机制。材料与方法：通过结合生物信息学与分子对接，首先筛选菘蓝中的生物活性成分及其对应的关键靶点，并预测其潜在作用机制。随后构建RSV肺炎小鼠模型，用于评估IRA介导的免疫器官参数、细胞因子产生及肺组织学变化。利用流式细胞术、qPCR分析及其他多种方法评估IRA对免疫调节的影响。接着，通过Western blotting和伊文思蓝实验评估上皮屏障修复情况。最终，利用基因沉默和Western blotting等技术及其他实验验证IRA的屏障保护效应是否特异性由芳香烃受体（AhR）介导。最后，利用AhR敲除（AhR KO）RSV肺炎小鼠模型验证IRA介导的屏障保护对AhR的特异性。结果：基于生物信息学分析和分子对接结果，生物碱被确定为菘蓝中介导其抗RSV肺炎作用的主要活性成分，且AhR被识别为关键靶点。在RSV肺炎小鼠模型中，IRA显著恢复免疫器官功能，改善炎症细胞因子水平，上调紧密连接蛋白表达，并增强肺屏障完整性。后续机制研究表明，AhR的激活是介导IRA效应的主要途径。最重要的是，AhR敲除完全消除了IRA对屏障功能的保护作用，证实该效应依赖于AhR通路。结论：我们的研究表明，IRA通过调节AhR活性发挥其对RSV肺炎的治疗作用并修复肺上皮屏障。这些发现表明IRA在RSV肺炎治疗中具有潜在价值。
